snippet.title: The Showdown: Gorilla vs 100 - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Hey everyone! I took the debate/meme and expanded on it to create a roguelite, ragdoll, brawler. Very excited for people to get their hands on it and experience the chaos.

All ears to community feedback!

Had a blast making this in my time away from work and family. Available on Steam to Wishlist if interested! "The Showdown: Gorilla vs 100"
